description.value: Deal 2d6 force damage (Heightened +1d6 every 2 levels). The damage looks like the target briefly being rendered as something else. Signal +2 to the spell DC and the damage die becomes d8.

cinderfall.incomplete: Unbuildable: the universal Signal-failure penalty (self-inflicted force damage + a Drift point on a failed check, the class's core Signal/Static mechanic) is not modeled -- a player toggling this on faces no in-sheet cost on a failed spell attack/DC. The class's Signal/Static mechanic has no rule-element analog anywhere in pf2e-source (`AdjustDegreeOfSuccess` evaluates before the roll resolves and cannot hook a GM's own secret post-roll check), and the Signal Drift track has no `SpecialResource`/counter representation.
cinderfall.listing: Glimpses / The Render Paradise building the world it wants
